goal: Prevent transaction broadcast from leaking sender identity through node connection state
Ensure privately broadcast transactions cannot be linked to the node via timing or peer manipulation
agreement: Strong support for isolating broadcast state to eliminate correlation leaks (darosior)
Answered objection: relying solely on DNS seeds and Tor risks outages and censorship (vasild)
Answered objection: restricting recipients to IP peers harms broader network privacy (vasild)
Questions dropping I2P and onion recipients in favor of built-in DNS seeds (andrewtoth)
Thinks low usage may warrant an out-of-tree hook or separate binary instead (ajtowns)

categories.name: p2p
why: P1 because current private broadcast leaks sender identity through shared node state
Fixes critical privacy leaks and peer manipulation risks that affect private transaction broadcast
